value.title: Role memory and the memory turn
Memory store: note document, slug, INDEX regeneration that keeps hand-written lines, list and read
value.notes: crates/daemon/src/community/memory.rs, pure (no git, no launch). Tests target it.

value.title: pij directory memory verbs: add (writer, one commit), view INDEX, --note; help text; CLI wiring
value.notes: http/directory.rs, core/directory.rs help, cli main.rs. add builds files inside write_with so two adds serialise on the worktree lock.

value.title: The memory turn before compact and close of a role holder
value.notes: send_control (compact) and lifecycle close. Waits on seat.activity idle after the prompt's delivery.outcome, bounded. Design pending pm-001 confirmation (self vs other caller).

value.title: Cost receipts: spawn sites and private-daemon spawn deltas per verb
Docs and states: pij-rs-api.md, skill verb coverage, roadmap s07, req-09, c-memory-hook

tk-0001.assertion: A unit test regenerates an INDEX holding hand-written lines (links, bare names, dot rows) and keeps every one, drops the empty placeholder, and adds exactly one line per pij note
A built note validates as pij/memory and its file name is <yyyy-mm-dd>-<slug>.dd.json; a title that slugs to nothing or escapes the folder is refused

tk-0002.assertion: In a scratch governance repo, memory add commits the note, its .dd.md and INDEX.md in one commit; two concurrent adds land as two commits and both INDEX lines survive
memory <role> prints the INDEX and --note <slug> prints one note; there is no delete verb and an unknown memory verb is refused by name

tk-0003.assertion: With a fake bus, compact of a role holder delivers the memory prompt first and admits the compact only after the seat's next idle; a non-holder is compacted with no prompt
When the bound passes with no turn end, the compact or close proceeds and its receipt says so (ended: bound)
Close of a role holder runs the memory turn before the tombstone; close of a non-holder is unchanged

tk-0004.assertion: spawn_sites.rs passes with any new launch site recorded; private-daemon spawn deltas per verb and live at-rest readings before and after are in the evidence

tk-0005.assertion: just ddocs-check and ddocs validate on docs/project pass; pij-rs-api.md and the skill verb tables name the memory verbs and refusals; roadmap s07 complete, req-09 and c-memory-hook shipped
